All 30 API tests pass in the existing Deno 2.9.4 stage-13 image with current source mounted read-only and network none. This does not prove that the hosted certificate is trusted or that invalid certificates are rejected in a real connection. Run a non-mutating SELECT 1 using the pinned runtime and approved pooler, plus a controlled invalid-certificate test. No production credentials or hosted database were accessed in this review.
